B-Sides

The studio’s notebook: everything that isn’t the single. Homages to book covers, posters and album sleeves, each redrawn from scratch with one of my projects in place of the original title, plus ideas for how a portfolio can behave. Some of these end up on the shelf; most just live here.

B-SidesChapter I · Covers

Covers

GUESS THE ORIGINAL

The rule for every cover: keep the layout, palette and lettering of the original, redraw the art from scratch, and swap the title for a project’s name. No brand marks are copied; each one carries the ADK star instead.

Name that cover. Each original is face down. Pick the book you think it is: get it right and the card turns over.

Concepts

Ideas for how a portfolio can behave. Each one is running on this site; try it on the right-hand page.

In this chapter
No. 01 · Bookcase

Every project is a book

The work page is a shelf. Each project gets a spine sized to its scope and a cover of its own, and you open a book to read it, the way you’d browse a real bookcase.

Live on the projects page
Open the library →
No. 02 · Motion

North, then east

The ADK star rests pointing north and swings east when you hover or act, like a compass needle settling on a heading. It’s the studio’s one signature move, on every button that takes you somewhere.

Live across the site
No. 03 · Footer

東奎, in stroke order

The footer writes my name in hanja stroke by stroke each time it scrolls into view, with a seal-red sun rising inside 東 and a clan-gold star landing on 奎.

Live in every footer
No. 04 · This book

A Supreme box, a compass star

The notebook’s own cover: the Supreme book’s red box holding the ADK tag, with “B-Sides” stamped in red below, led by the East star.

On the shelf
